validation_strategy: Full suite with real browser, followed by targeted validation of the only subsequently changed source component (external gate). Not a claim of one fresh 95-test full-suite run.

before_fix_recovery_suite.classification: Intentional red regression run on the unchanged baseline

full_suite.qualification: Runtime source is final. During this run the external gate's interpreter invocation path was corrected; the final gate and one added regression were tested separately below.

limits: No new competition score or measured model-quality/cost improvement.
External gate is a developer-contract/protocol boundary, not an OS sandbox or automatically correct semantic judge.
Application-to-snapshot binding is supplied by the operator; sandbox and suite-specific official reporter integration remain.
Pi adapter and matched real-model comparison are not implemented or run.
Changed SDK per-requirement progress event behavior has not been verified with an official run.
